text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests, on the other hand, check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Good testing gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they can change the code without worrying about breaking things. In the end, testing saves time and makes software more reliable.
